info.description:
This document describes how developers access Flink flight APIs through the Open Platform unified authentication system.

Entry point: `/openapi/v1/flink/*`.

Required authentication headers: `X-OP-App-Key`, `X-OP-Timestamp`, `X-OP-Nonce`, `X-OP-Sign`.

The signature rules match the Glink document: join `METHOD`, `PATH`, sorted query, body SHA256, timestamp, nonce, and appKey with newline characters, then sign the string with the application secret using HMAC-SHA256.

Timestamps may be Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, or RFC3339.

Supplier-side `appid`, `timestamp`, and `sign` are generated automatically by the platform runtime from the application-supplier mapping. Clients must not send them themselves.

Successful responses return `code=SUCCESS`; supplier business failures may still return HTTP 200 with `code=SUPPLIER_BIZ_ERROR`.
info.title: Flink Flight Open API Documentation (Platform Authentication Edition)

200.description: The platform has completed authentication and downstream forwarding. When `code=SUCCESS`, `data` contains the Flink business response object. Supplier business failures may still return HTTP 200 with `code=SUPPLIER_BIZ_ERROR`.
